# The 92 family — what the recorded runs support

Environment note: `.venv/` was absent from this checkout and every script hardcodes
`../.venv/bin/python`. Rebuilt with `python -m venv .venv` + `pip install -e ".[openai]"`
(Python 3.13); `run_ablation.py --list-variants` resolves all seven of `s_linker92`,
`s_linker92a`…`s_linker92f`.

**Only one arm of the family has end-to-end runs in this checkout.**

| variant | recorded five-project runs | what prices it |
|---|---|---|
| `s_linker92a` | **6** — terra r1–r3, luna r1–r3 (`../regex_e2e_*_20260822`) | the tables below |
| `s_linker92` | 0 — the control set `../solo_e2e_{terra,luna}_r*_20260821` is **absent** | level 1/2 only |
| `s_linker92b`–`s_linker92f` | 0 | level 1/2 only (`README.md`) |

So the tables below are **levels, not deltas.** The regex round's ctl-vs-scan comparison
in `README.md` cannot be regenerated here: its control arm's link CSVs and phase states
are not in this checkout and not on this host. The `compact_e2e_*_20260821` directories
do carry recorded runs, but of `s_linker89` (terra mean TP 186.3 / FP 24.0, macro F1
94.19), which is a different arm, not the round's control. `pilot/score_runs.py` on the
tables below reproduces `README.md`'s scan column exactly, which is what confirms the
scoring path rather than any delta.

Call counts are **not recoverable** for these runs: the `regex_e2e_*` directories carry no
`llm_logs/`, so `finetune_e2e_table.py`'s calls column reads `nan` and `README.md`'s
75.3 / 79.0 stands on the original invocation's logs alone.

Regenerate:

    ../.venv/bin/python pilot/arm_tables.py --arm s_linker92a \
        --model terra ../results/regex_e2e_terra_r*_20260822 \
        --model luna  ../results/regex_e2e_luna_r*_20260822
